notes:
Community graphics packs for Wii U, two clean new themes, and a batch of fixes from your reports.

Wii U games now come with the community graphics packs built in. Open a Wii U game's
pre-launch menu and choose Community Packs, then browse by category: cheats, enhancements,
graphics, mods and workarounds. Turning down resolution or shadows here can make a game
noticeably smoother, and some packs fix games that would not launch at all.

Two new themes, clean light and clean dark, with no glow. Pick one in Settings.

The file manager page has a new Shader / Graphics Packs section. Your games are listed by
console and you can upload a shader cache or a texture pack to any of them. GameCube, Wii,
Wii U, 3DS, PSP and PS2 are covered, and the emulator's own setting is switched on for you.

Also new: a WiFi indicator and clock in the status bar, sorting per console, a deep sleep
shortcut on the Home button, wired Ethernet, pointer icon options, and two more PS2
performance options for games with graphical glitches.

Fixed: PlayStation analog sticks that stayed dead for some controllers, PS2 memory cards
ejecting when you loaded a save state, and the performance overlay drawing white edges
around every row.
